summary: Test calls the real parseSpec on six filenames and asserts grammar-visible outcomes, not labels: codex-session-scrollback.md parses clean with docId=stem (would fail if legacy grammar were applied to its bare '### 1:' headings), REQ-5-widgets.md and REQ-12-widgets.md yield legacy docIds REQ-5/REQ-12 with no violations, and the three near misses the requirement forbids classifying as legacy — lowercase req-5-widgets, REQ-widgets (prefix with zero digits), and widgets.md under prefix ACME-REQ — each yield the whole basename as stem.
